description: Capability registry. Descriptive only: capabilities grant no authority. Schema: schemas/capability.schema.json.

capabilities.name: Architecture
capabilities.description: System structure, component boundaries, cross-cutting technical decisions, ADRs.
capabilities.risk_notes: Often produces D3 decisions; requires ADR.

capabilities.name: Backend
capabilities.description: Server-side and core application logic, services, internal APIs.

capabilities.name: Frontend
capabilities.description: Client-side UI implementation, state management, accessibility.

capabilities.name: Game development
capabilities.description: Gameplay systems, engine integration, content pipelines, game feel.
capabilities.risk_notes: Game feel often needs G-HUMAN at outcome level.

capabilities.name: Database
capabilities.description: Schema design, migrations, queries, data integrity.
capabilities.risk_notes: Persistent schema changes have a D3 floor; migrating existing data is often D4.

capabilities.name: Testing
capabilities.description: Test design, coverage, harnesses, flake diagnosis.

capabilities.name: Code review
capabilities.description: Independent review of diffs for correctness, clarity, and adherence to decisions.
capabilities.risk_notes: Must not review its own production (separation of duties).

capabilities.name: Security
capabilities.description: Threat modelling, auth, secrets handling, dependency audit, security review.
capabilities.risk_notes: Security-sensitive changes have a D3 floor and frequently D4.

capabilities.name: DevOps
capabilities.description: CI/CD, build tooling, environments, containers, infrastructure-as-code.
capabilities.risk_notes: CI changes have a D2 floor; real infrastructure is D4.

capabilities.name: Performance
capabilities.description: Profiling, benchmarking, optimization against measured baselines.

capabilities.name: UX
capabilities.description: Interaction design, information architecture, usability, visual design direction.

capabilities.name: Product analysis
capabilities.description: Translating vision into outcomes, scoping milestones, prioritization, naming.

capabilities.name: Research
capabilities.description: Investigating options, prior art, libraries; producing evidence for decisions.
capabilities.risk_notes: Consumes untrusted external content; outputs are agent_output until verified.

capabilities.name: Release engineering
capabilities.description: Versioning, changelogs, packaging, release readiness checks.
capabilities.risk_notes: Publishing a release is external communication (D4).
